answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 12134 Country: United Kingdom Title: Salam Alaikum wrwb! More than a year back my sister saw dream in which I met with an accident and one of my hands was severed. At that time my younger brother got married to a girl with out the knowledge of our family. As this girl does not belong to a good family, she was not accepted in our family. I interpreted this dream of my sister as losing my borther. But few months later I got separated from my wife and despite several attempts it now down to Khula. Kindly let me know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallahu Khair Question: Salam Alaikum wrwb! More than a year back my sister saw dream in which I met with an accident and one of my hands was severed. At that time my younger brother got married to a girl with out the knowledge of our family. As this girl does not belong to a good family, she was not accepted in our family. I interpreted this dream of my sister as losing my borther. But few months later I got separated from my wife and despite several attempts it now down to Khula. Kindly let me know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallahu Khair Answer ID: 12134 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 948/725=H/1430) The meaning you understood is right, there is no need for any other interpretation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
